next.task: Try the d-pad in focus mode

done.note: Source starts a live view by itself; shutter freezes and re-presses resume. Fixes the stuck-on-capturing bug.
Selectable rotation and a fill mode that crops instead of letterboxing. Print matches the previewed framing.
Press tick and a settle tick, so a 1.5s refresh is acknowledged immediately.

Canvases sized so one source pixel covers a whole number of device pixels.
